model.summary: Model favors DET by 3.4 points (58% win chance). Biggest factors: Rest days (home minus away) (DET +1.4), Home team off a bye (GB +1.1), Rushing offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (DET +0.9). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 49.2 total points (DET 26, GB 23). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 2.2), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 1.3), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 1.2). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
